question: kendaraan dengan perjalanan terbanyak
sql: SELECT v.vehicle_name, COUNT(t.id) AS total FROM vehicle v LEFT JOIN trip t ON v.id = t.vehicle_id GROUP BY v.id ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 1

question: total biaya bahan bakar per kendaraan
sql: SELECT v.vehicle_name, SUM(f.fuel_price_total) AS total_fuel FROM vehicle v LEFT JOIN fuel f ON v.id = f.vehicle_id GROUP BY v.id ORDER BY total_fuel DESC
